panel_ca.title: Reading the panel's certificate
panel_ca.description:
Home Assistant fetches the certificate authority your panel publishes, and checks that the certificate the panel serves is signed by it. This happens before you enter your passphrase, so the passphrase and the credentials the panel returns for it travel over a verified connection rather than in the clear.

Select **Submit** to try again.

data_description.allow_contextless_control: Automations, scripts and other integrations call services with no user attached. Turning this off refuses those commands. Leave it on unless your automations do not operate circuits.
data_description.control_lock_timeout: -1 turns the control lock off and removes its switch. 0 keeps the lock armed until someone disarms it. Any other value re-arms it that many minutes after it is disarmed. Only administrators can disarm it.
data_description.control_mode: Home Assistant grants every non-admin user control of every entity by default. Restricting to administrators is the only way to change that. Disabling stops creating the control entities; their registry entries, names and areas are kept.
data_description.enable_circuit_net_energy_sensors: Net energy per circuit, accounting for reactive power.
data_description.enable_energy_dip_compensation: Compensate when panel reports lower energy readings. Disabling clears offsets.
data_description.enable_panel_net_energy_sensors: Net energy for main meter and feed-through, accounting for bidirectional flows.
data_description.enable_unmapped_circuit_sensors: Backing sensors for tabs not assigned to named breakers.
data_description.energy_reporting_grace_period: Minutes sensors hold last value when panel is offline (0–60). Default: 15.
data_description.panel_admin_only: Restrict the dashboard sidebar entry to admin users.
data_description.relay_debounce_seconds: Refuse a second command to the same circuit's relay within this many seconds. Refused, never queued: a relay command firing seconds late against a changed panel is worse than an error the automation author can see. 0 disables it.
data_description.show_panel: Display the SPAN Panel dashboard as a sidebar entry.
data_description.snapshot_update_interval: Seconds between snapshot rebuilds (0–15). Lower = faster, more CPU. 0 = no debounce.

rotate_credentials.name: Rotate panel credentials
rotate_credentials.description: Ask the SPAN panel for a new eBus MQTT broker password, store it, and reload the integration. The previous broker password stops working immediately, so any other local client using it — a second Home Assistant instance, a script, or third-party tooling — must be re-provisioned from the panel before it will reconnect. The panel access token and the panel passphrase are not changed. Only a Home Assistant administrator can run this, and it cannot be called from an automation or script.

confirm.title: Trust the new certificate authority?
confirm.description:
{panel} is now advertising this certificate authority:

**{fingerprint}**

Accepting pins it and reconnects. Only do that if you know why it changed — a firmware upgrade or a factory reset rotates it legitimately.

If nothing should have changed, do not accept. A device on your network standing in for your panel looks exactly like this, and accepting would hand it the connection.

abort.ca_leaf_mismatch: The certificate this panel serves is not signed by the authority it published, so that authority has not been offered for you to accept and nothing has been changed. Check that the HTTPS port is correct and that nothing is intercepting the connection, then try again.
